index.name: SGM Studios - Suno AI Workflow Suite
index.description: Six-script pipeline for importing, organizing, and mastering Suno AI audio in REAPER. Import ZIP files, rename/categorize tracks, detect BPM, split at structural boundaries, normalize loudness, and align stems — end to end, no coding required.

reapack.name: SGM_Suno ZIP Importer.lua
reapack.desc: Import a Suno AI ZIP file: unzip, parse metadata, create color-coded session with lyrics markers

version.author: Scott Mills
version.changelog: + Replace non-existent reaper.GetTempPath() with project/resource media path + Keep extracted audio files on disk after import (prevents Media Offline) + Fix json_string() key/value offset bug (was returning ": " instead of value) + Guard removed reaper.ImGui_DestroyContext() on ReaImGui 0.9+/0.10+ + Replace undefined lfs and shell dir calls with native REAPER APIs + Fix SWS detection (reaper.CF_GetSWSVersion)

reapack.name: Suno_01_MetadataOrganizer.lua
reapack.desc: Scan tracks, parse Suno AI filenames, rename tracks, assign colors, and tag metadata

version.author: Scott Mills
version.changelog: + Resolve parent source for section/reversed items and guard empty filenames + Fix CSV parsing when a field is left blank in GetUserInputs + Fix unique song count when all processed tracks are stems

reapack.name: Suno_02_TempoMapper.lua
reapack.desc: Analyse a selected Suno audio item, estimate BPM, and insert a REAPER tempo marker

version.author: Scott Mills
version.changelog: + Fix REAPER API call: GetMediaItemTake_Peaks (was MediaItemTake_GetPeaks) + Fix peak buffer size (2 * num_chans * n_req), interleaved indexing, and retval bitmask + Pass item_pos as starttime to GetMediaItemTake_Peaks + Fix GetUserInputs prompt formatting and CSV parsing

reapack.name: Suno_03_DynamicSplitter.lua
reapack.desc: Split Suno audio items at structural boundaries (verse/chorus/bridge) using energy contrast

version.author: Scott Mills
version.changelog: + Fix REAPER API call: GetMediaItemTake_Peaks (was MediaItemTake_GetPeaks) + Fix peak buffer size (2 * num_chans * n_frames), interleaved indexing, and retval bitmask + Pass item_pos as starttime to GetMediaItemTake_Peaks + Fix CSV parsing when a field is left blank in GetUserInputs

reapack.name: Suno_04_LoudnessMaster.lua
reapack.desc: Batch-normalise selected Suno items to a target integrated loudness level

version.author: Scott Mills
version.changelog: + Fix REAPER API call: GetMediaItemTake_Peaks (was MediaItemTake_GetPeaks) + Fix peak buffer size (2 * num_chans * n_req), interleaved indexing, and retval bitmask + Pass item_pos as starttime to GetMediaItemTake_Peaks + Account for existing item D_VOL so re-running is idempotent

reapack.name: Suno_05_StemAligner.lua
reapack.desc: Organise third-party stem separations (UVR5, Demucs, Fadr) into a mix-ready layout

version.author: Scott Mills
version.changelog: + Resolve parent source for section/reversed items and guard empty filenames + Allow creating summing bus even when folder creation is disabled + Guard CreateTrackSend return value and fix CSV parsing

reapack.name: SGM SunoWorkflow Bundle.lua
reapack.desc: SGM Studios Suno AI Workflow Suite: six-script pipeline for importing and preparing Suno AI tracks

version.author: Scott Mills
version.changelog: + Fix GetMediaItemTake_Peaks API name, buffer size, interleaved layout, and starttime in 02/03/04 + SGM_Suno ZIP Importer 1.1.2: fix GetTempPath, json_string offset, ImGui_DestroyContext, lfs, and keep imported audio on disk + Suno_01_MetadataOrganizer 1.0.3 & Suno_05_StemAligner 1.0.3: parent source resolution & CSV/bus fixes
